help.guide.hold.s1: Tap Hold — the basket is saved and shown as a small button above the tabs.
help.guide.hold.s2: Serve the next person. When the first customer returns, tap their saved basket to continue.
help.guide.hold.title: 5 · Customer forgot something?
help.guide.intro: Everything you need for a normal day, in small steps. You cannot break anything by trying — take your time.
help.guide.language.s1: Tap the language letters at the top of the screen (for example EN or FA) and pick yours. Everything changes at once.
help.guide.language.title: 8 · Change the language
help.guide.login.s1: Turn the till on. When the number pad appears, type your PIN.
help.guide.login.s2: You are in! The big screen with product pictures is where you sell.
help.guide.login.title: 1 · Start your day
help.guide.noscan.s1: Type the first letters of the product's name in the box at the top — it will find it.
help.guide.noscan.s2: Or tap the product's picture on the screen.
help.guide.noscan.s3: If your till has the camera button 📷, tap it, take a photo of the product, and pick the right match.
help.guide.noscan.title: 6 · The barcode won't scan
help.guide.pay.s1: When everything is in the basket, look at the Pay area.
help.guide.pay.s2: Tap Cash if they pay cash, Card if they pay by card. That's it — the sale is done.
help.guide.pay.s3: Paying part cash, part card? Use the Split tab and add each payment.
help.guide.pay.title: 3 · Take the money
help.guide.receipt.s1: After paying, the receipt appears. Tap Print if the customer wants a copy.
help.guide.receipt.s2: Tap New customer and you are ready for the next person.
help.guide.receipt.title: 4 · Receipt and the next customer
help.guide.sell.s1: Point the scanner at the barcode — beep — the item appears in the basket on the left.
help.guide.sell.s2: No barcode? Tap the product's picture instead.
help.guide.sell.s3: You can also type the name or code in the box at the top and press Add.
help.guide.sell.title: 2 · Sell something
help.guide.shift.s1: Go to Shifts in the menu and tap Open shift — count the cash in the drawer and enter it.
help.guide.shift.s2: At the end of the day, go back to Shifts, count the drawer again, and close the shift.
help.guide.shift.s3: The till shows any difference for you — no maths needed.
help.guide.shift.title: 7 · Opening and closing the day
help.guide.title: How to use the till
help.guide.trouble.s1: Internet down? Keep selling — the till works without it and catches up later.
help.guide.trouble.s2: Tapped something by mistake? Nothing is lost — the basket stays until you finish or reset it.
help.guide.trouble.s3: Still stuck? Ask your manager, or open Help / FAQ in the menu for more answers.
help.guide.trouble.title: 9 · Something looks wrong?

settings.backup.help: The till saves a daily snapshot of its database automatically (newest 14 are kept). Download copies to a USB stick or another device — a backup that lives only on this machine cannot save you from a broken machine.
settings.backup.none_yet: No backups yet — the first daily snapshot happens a couple of minutes after the till starts.

settings.data.warn: This permanently deletes ALL sales, shifts and invoices (not only test ones) and cannot be undone — it is a one-time reset before going live. The action itself is recorded in the audit log.

settings.enrol.benefits: Registering is free and connects your till to the plugin store: install plugins with one tap and unlock cloud features as they arrive. It happens automatically when the till is online — or register now with the button below.
settings.enrol.claim_expires: The code is valid for 15 minutes.
settings.enrol.claim_help: Link this store to your Universal Till ID to manage it online (My stores, fleet, paid features). Generate a code, then sign in on the marketplace and enter it.
settings.enrol.claim_open: Open the claim page and enter the code

settings.printer.help: Print receipts silently on a thermal printer. Network mode talks to any WiFi/Ethernet ESC/POS printer; device mode writes to a plugged-in USB printer (e.g. /dev/usb/lp0 on Linux/Pi).
settings.printer.kitchen_help: A separate printer for kitchen tickets — network host:port (e.g. 192.168.1.60:9100) or a device path. Leave empty to turn kitchen printing off.
settings.printer.system_hint: For a regular office printer (e.g. HP), pick “Regular printer” — receipts are sent as plain text to the system default printer. Put a specific printer name in Address to target it, or leave blank for the default. Thermal printers use Network or USB device (ESC/POS).

help.features.title: Features
help.features.intro: Everything your till can do — tap a feature to see what it is and how to use it.
help.feat.sell.title: Selling & checkout
help.feat.sell.what: The main register screen: scan or pick items, take payment, print or skip the receipt. It works fully offline — a network outage never blocks a sale.
help.feat.sell.s1: Scan a barcode, or search / tap the item on the sell screen.
help.feat.sell.s2: Adjust quantity or remove lines in the basket, then choose Pay.
help.feat.sell.s3: Hold a basket to serve the next customer and recall it later; refunds are under the sale history.
help.feat.catalog.title: Catalog, variants & barcodes
help.feat.catalog.what: Your products: names, prices, departments, item variants (size, flavour…) and any number of barcodes per item or per variant.
help.feat.catalog.s1: Open Catalog and click an item row — the editor panel below shows all its variants and barcodes.
help.feat.catalog.s2: Edit variant names, SKUs, prices, cost prices and photos right in the grid; add or remove barcodes as chips; print labels per variant.
help.feat.catalog.s3: Use Import to load items from a CSV file, and Export to save your catalog.
help.feat.inventory.title: Stock & inventory
help.feat.inventory.what: Tracks on-hand quantities per item and variant. Sales reduce stock automatically; goods-in and adjustments record deliveries and corrections.
help.feat.inventory.s1: Open Inventory to see current stock levels.
help.feat.inventory.s2: Record a delivery with goods-in; use an adjustment for waste, breakage or count corrections.
help.feat.inventory.s3: The inventory page predicts how many days of stock remain and suggests how much to order; the reports page carries a low-stock alert chip too.
help.feat.reports.title: Reports & end of day
help.feat.reports.what: Sales totals by day, department and payment type; best and slow sellers; dead stock; busiest days and hours; margins; tax summary; year-over-year — plus the end-of-day (Z) report for cashing up.
help.feat.reports.s1: Open Reports and choose the period or department view you need.
help.feat.reports.s2: Run End of day when you close: it totals the day and can print for your records.
help.feat.invoices.title: Invoices & tax invoices
help.feat.invoices.what: Issue a proper (tax) invoice for a sale — for business customers or wherever a titled invoice is required.
help.feat.invoices.s1: Open Invoices, pick the sale, and fill in the customer details.
help.feat.invoices.s2: Print it or reprint any past invoice from the list.
help.feat.printing.title: Receipts & printing
help.feat.printing.what: Prints receipts, invoices and end-of-day reports on a thermal receipt printer or a regular office printer; kitchen orders can print to a separate printer.
help.feat.printing.s1: In Settings choose your printer and its type — thermal or regular.
help.feat.printing.s2: Use the test print button to check the connection.
help.feat.printing.s3: A kitchen printer can be set separately so food orders print where they are prepared.
help.feat.designer.title: Receipt & screen designer
help.feat.designer.what: Customise what your receipt shows (logo, header, footer) and arrange the sell-screen buttons to fit how you work.
help.feat.designer.s1: Open the receipt designer to change the logo and receipt text; changes preview live.
help.feat.designer.s2: Use the screen designer to arrange quick buttons for your best-selling items.
help.feat.payments.title: Payments
help.feat.payments.what: Cash is built in; card and other payment methods come as plugins from the store — for example Stripe with a card reader (terminal) or QR-code payment.
help.feat.payments.s1: Install a payment plugin from the Plugin store and enter your account keys in its settings.
help.feat.payments.s2: If you use a card reader, set its id in the plugin settings on that till.
help.feat.payments.s3: At checkout, the preferred method leads and each button can show an estimated fee (set provider fees in Settings → Payments) — pick the cheaper one; a declined card leaves the basket untouched.
help.feat.multitill.title: Multiple tills (one shop)
help.feat.multitill.what: Run several tills on the same shop network: one is the main till, the others join it and share the catalog, prices, settings and stock automatically.
help.feat.multitill.s1: Install the till app on the second device and choose Join on its setup screen.
help.feat.multitill.s2: Enter the main till's address (shown in its Settings) to pair them.
help.feat.multitill.s3: Sales made on any till flow back to the main till, and catalog changes spread to all tills within about half a minute.
help.feat.plugins.title: Plugin store
help.feat.plugins.what: Add features without changing the core app: payments, themes, language packs, integrations, AI tools and more. Every plugin is signed and verified before it runs.
help.feat.plugins.s1: Open Plugins → Store to browse the catalog.
help.feat.plugins.s2: Install with one click; plugins carry trust badges (gold = official Universal Till, green = verified developer) and unverified publishers ask for your confirmation first.
help.feat.plugins.s3: Each plugin has its own settings page; some settings are shared shop-wide, others are per till.
help.feat.claim.title: Store registration & claiming
help.feat.claim.what: Registering connects your till to the Universal Till marketplace; claiming links the store to YOUR account so you get the online back-office (My stores, fleet view) and paid features.
help.feat.claim.s1: Settings → Till registration shows the store identity; Register now connects it if needed.
help.feat.claim.s2: Click Claim this store to get a short code (valid 15 minutes) and a QR — scan it with your phone to claim from there.
help.feat.claim.s3: Sign in to the marketplace with your Universal Till ID, open the claim page and enter the code.
help.feat.users.title: Users, PINs & shifts
help.feat.users.what: Separate cashier and manager accounts with PIN login, and shift tracking so you know who sold what and when the drawer was counted.
help.feat.users.s1: Manage accounts under Users; managers can access settings and reports, cashiers can sell.
help.feat.users.s2: Each person signs in with their PIN on the till.
help.feat.users.s3: Open and close shifts to track drawer counts per person.
help.feat.backups.title: Backups
help.feat.backups.what: Snapshots of all your shop data (catalog, sales, settings) that you can download and keep somewhere safe.
help.feat.backups.s1: Settings → Backups: create a backup any time.
help.feat.backups.s2: Download saves a copy to your Downloads folder — keep one off the till.
help.feat.updates.title: Software updates
help.feat.updates.what: The till checks for new versions and tells you when one is available; on most platforms it updates itself with one click.
help.feat.updates.s1: Settings → Software update → Check now shows whether you are up to date.
help.feat.updates.s2: When an update is offered, click Update now — the app restarts on the new version.
help.feat.display.title: Languages & display
help.feat.display.what: The whole till speaks English, Türkçe, فارسی and العربية — including right-to-left layout — and adapts to touch screens with an on-screen keyboard and adjustable text size.
help.feat.display.s1: Change the language from the menu; each user can pick their own.
help.feat.display.s2: Settings → Display: adjust the UI scale for your screen.
help.feat.display.s3: The on-screen keyboard pops up automatically on touch screens (or force it on/off in Display settings).
settings.enrol.claim_scan: Or scan with your phone to claim there

settings.payments.default_help: The preferred method appears first at checkout — put your cheapest or house provider here.
settings.payments.fees_help: Provider fees (what each provider charges you): percent + fixed per transaction. Checkout shows an estimated fee next to each button so the cashier can pick the cheaper one.
reports.seasonal_hint: What sold in the NEXT four weeks in past years (averaged, lunar-calendar shifts included), your stock now, and how much to order to match it.
reports.seasonal_lunar_hint: This item's demand follows the lunar calendar (moves about 11 days earlier each year); its history window is shifted to match.
help.feat.alerts.title: Alerts & notifications
help.feat.alerts.what: The till watches your business and warns you early: items about to run out, days of stock left, order suggestions, and unusually high or low sales days.
help.feat.alerts.s1: Inventory shows days-left and order suggestions; Reports carries a low-stock chip.
help.feat.alerts.s2: A registered till also sends a daily digest to your online My shop inbox on the marketplace.
help.feat.alerts.s3: Unusual sales days (much higher or lower than that weekday normally) are flagged automatically.

issuereport.title: Report an issue
issuereport.intro: Describe what happened by typing or recording a voice note (and optionally your screen), plus the till's recent logs. Saved on this till immediately — it's queued to upload once this shop is online.
issuereport.note_placeholder: Describe what happened, e.g. which screen, what you tapped… (or use voice below)
issuereport.description_required: Type a description or record a voice note.
issuereport.saved: Saved. It will upload automatically once this shop is online.
issuereport.save_error: Couldn't save the report — try again.
issuereport.logs_note: The till's recent warning/error logs are attached automatically.
